fix(group-monitor): 多Agent同名防混淆与伴侣专属提问高优先级响应

- DEFAULT_GROUP_SYSTEM_PROMPT: 增加唯一自我认同与发言归属原则，仅【我方】属于自己，未标记【我方】一律视为外部群友
- DEFAULT_FLASH_GATE_PROMPT: 区分伴侣与普通群友，伴侣呼唤/提问属最高优先级定向事件，同名抢答绝不放弃开口

group-monitor: add Windows launcher with log redirection

Task Scheduler used to invoke python.exe directly, so all stdout/stderr
from the monitor was discarded - which made gate failures impossible to
diagnose after the fact.

start_wechat_group_monitor.bat now:
- cds to its own directory, resolves paths relative to itself
- runs python with -u so output is unbuffered
- appends stdout+stderr to logs\monitor.log
- rotates the log at 10MB into monitor.log.1 (silently skips rotation if
  a live instance still holds the file)
- honours PYTHON and SCRIPT env vars so renamed/relocated deployments work
- records an explicit error line and exits 2 if the entry script is missing

README: document the bat launcher under the Windows section.

docs: 新增上手指南并完成 ga-api 侧去个人化

给朋友和她们的 agent 一份可直接照做的部署文档，并把 ga-api 侧残留的
个人化命名彻底清成中性词，与微信监控侧保持一致。

新增：
- GETTING_STARTED.md：整体架构、部署顺序(API→私聊→群聊)、配置提醒清单、
  平台差异、跑通验证、排错对照表；根 README 顶部与文档索引加入入口。
- GETTING_STARTED.md 第 2.5 节「命名变更提醒」：旧名→新名对照表，并重点
  强调两类连带影响，要求 agent 部署时主动核对——
  · 记忆宫殿 wing 名 xavier_api→agent_api：升级且已用过宫殿者直接改名会

  · 模型 ID：ga_api_config.json 的 model.id ↔ 监控配置 agent.model ↔
    check_ga_api.sh 测试模型名三处必须一致，改后须重启 API 服务。

- ga_api_server.py / ga_api_native_server.py：model.id、model.name、
